Title: Whistling Up the Beast + Bestial Vengeance

Messages.Author: ontheverge
Messages.Body:
If a vampire plays Bestial Vengeance, can xe then play Whistling Up
the Beast (or any other cards that include the "Frenzy" text)? Xe is
only "immune" to frenzy cards played by other vampires, right?

Bestial Vengeance
Combat
Animalism
Requires a Laibon.
[ani] Only usable before range is determined. Choose a retainer on
this Laibon. This combat, this Laibon is immune to frenzy cards and
the opposing minion takes 1 damage during strike resolution if the
retainer is ready. A vampire can play only one Bestial Vengeance each
combat.
[ANI] As above, but for 2 damage.

Whistling Up the Beast
Combat
Abombwe
[abo] Cancel a frenzy card played on this vampire as it is played.
[abo] Frenzy. Only usable before range is determined on the first
round. During this combat, the opposing vampire cannot use maneuvers
to maneuver to close range and cannot use presses to continue combat.
[ABO] As above, and this vampire gets an optional maneuver this round.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Jun 29, 8:50 pm, ontheverge <marta.bashov...@gmail.com> wrote:
> If a vampire plays Bestial Vengeance, can xe then play Whistling Up
> the Beast (or any other cards that include the "Frenzy" text)?

Yes.

> Xe is
> only "immune" to frenzy cards played by other vampires, right?

No. Xe's immune to all frenzy cards.
Note that Whistling Up the Beast is a frenzy on the opposing vampire.
There are very few self-frenzy cards.



Messages.Author: ontheverge
Messages.Body:

Thanks a lot. A follow up: if I play Whistling Up the Beast and
Drawing Out the Beast at the same time, is the opposing vampire
completely unable to maneuver or press? ...I can play two frenzy
cards on an opposing vampire, right? I couldn't find anything in the
rules about frenzy cards.

Drawing Out the Beast
Combat
Animalism
Only usable before range is determined on the first round. Frenzy.
[ani] During this combat, opposing vampire gets +1 strength, but he or
she cannot use maneuvers to maneuver to long range, cannot use presses
to end combat and cannot use equipment. A vampire may play only one
Drawing Out the Beast each combat.
[ANI] As above, and the opposing vampire takes 1 unpreventable damage
during the press step each round.
